propositions: Store-wide compaction sweep performs one git log walk per ticket inside the store write lock, causing writers to stall for minutes; deployed reality worse than per-ticket due to per-event wildcard-pathspec walks falling through from map misses.

The authorship ledger builder calls resolve_event_commit per-event inside the lock; must use position-keyed build_position_commit_map (not path-keyed build_introducing_commit_map which silently misses every lookup) built once per sweep outside lock.
Staging via unscoped git add -A commits concurrent writers' in-flight event files into the compaction commit; must scope to folded ticket paths only.
Sweep never re-probes write_lock_is_busy between tickets, so writers arriving after sweep starts wait for entire run; must re-yield mid-loop in compact_all_cli.
New map parameter on _build_authorship_ledger must be optional (keyword, default None) for compatibility with compact_rebuild.py:160 and existing test call sites.
